original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-product}
If $U$ and $V$ are simplicial objects in the category $\mathcal{C}$,
and if $U \times V$ exists, then we have
$$
\Mor(W, U \times V) =
\Mor(W, U) \times
\Mor(W, V)
$$
for any third simplicial object $W$ of $\mathcal{C}$.
